top_signals.title: AI Slump Deepens as Taiwan Drops Most in a Year: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks slumped, with tech bellwether Taiwan dropping the most in more than a year, extending a post-election rout in chipmakers that deepened on Wall Street on growing concern that Democrats will seek tighter regulation of the artificial intelligence industry.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Taiwan’s Currency Weakens Past 33 Per US Dollar on AI Jitters
top_signals.summary: The Taiwan dollar weakened past the key psychological level of 33 per US dollar for the first time since April 2025, as a broad retreat in artificial intelligence shares weighed on the island’s tech-heavy equity market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Copper Moves Lower as US Election Undermines AI and Tariff Trade
top_signals.summary: Copper slumped to its lowest since July as a political shakeup in Washington threatened to blunt two key bullish drivers: the rapid buildout of AI infrastructure, and the risk of US import tariffs on the metal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
